row:
Welcome to Four Paws Holistic Therapy!
Have you ever wondered what your pet is truly feeling, thinking, or trying to tell you? This channel is dedicated to exploring the world of animal communication and holistic healing, to help you understand your companions and connect with them on a deeper level.
Hosted by Gillian Edwards, CCMT, RMT, CAC a Certified Animal Communicator, Reiki Master/Teacher, and Canine Massage Therapist, who bridges the gap between you and your pets through telepathic animal communication, energy healing, and hands-on bodywork.

On this channel, you'll find:
Insights into how animal communication works 
Tips for deepening the bond between you and your animal companions
Guidance on holistic pet wellness
Practical advice for your animal companion

Want to understand your animal's emotional and physical wellbeing?
🐾 Book a session/learn more at: fourpawsholistictherapy.com
Bringing wellbeing, comfort, and balance to our animal companions, one conversation at a time.
